cache_policy: Exact requested-URI Arelle Linux cache mapping; no unrecorded URL alias substitution; pinned built-ins and existing captures reused by hard link. Source bytes staged locally unchanged. Safe redirect allowlist; unsafe URLs refused and retained.
network_order: deterministic source seed order followed by breadth-first traversal, sorted outgoing URIs, one attempt per unique URI, sequential HTTP requests
phase: Frozen after final helper closure and read-only driver/binding review; before first v17 offline source worker
previous_protocol_status: published unexecuted v16.3 draft; its stale draft bindings are not reused as executable bindings
purpose: Conventional all-source XBRL/Inline/DTS validation under explicit options; no natural QA, financial truth or SEC original-byte claim

resource_policy.RSS_monitor: Retained direct-child ownership anchor resolves inner PID namespace against outer /proc, including exact-outer-PPID fallback when task children interface is absent; summed owned-group RSS; missing/live-zero telemetry refuses; cleanup required before next source.
resource_policy.limitations: Conservative intentionally overlapping sum; sequential non-atomic reads and polling may miss transient peaks; no formal bound on every unreclaimable allocation; kernel settings unchanged.
resource_policy.oom_baseline_scope: run-global, before first source loop; preserved across all12 sources
resource_policy.prelaunch_rule: proxy + reserve strictly less than proxy limit
resource_policy.run_rule: proxy strictly less than limit; any new global-baseline oom or oom_kill event stops own process

status_interpretation.completed_without_errors_limit: Under listed Arelle options only, not SEC EFM/compliance, arithmetic verification or financial truth.
status_interpretation.monitored_limits_note: 0.1-second watchdogs, not OS-enforced hard memory sandbox.
status_interpretation.numeric_comparison: Exact Decimal/int finite values at matching source SHA+DOM locator; unsupported/nonfinite/inexact types and status differences remain separate.
status_interpretation.validation_status: incomplete_DTS or completed_with_errors or completed_without_errors, separate from technical status; noncompletion explicitly retained

validation_gate: Dependency graph hash frozen before first offline validation. Root/table extraction completion required before heavy validation. Source files remain all12 even for resource/process failures.
